The issuer shows solid operating and profitability metrics (EBIT margin ~23% and net margin ~13%) and adequate short-term liquidity (current ratio ~1.35). Leverage is moderate, with total liabilities at ~65% of total assets, but the sizeable equity base (shareholders’ equity ~35% of assets) provides meaningful balance-sheet support. Overall, this supports a strong, but not top-tier, credit profile.  
DECISION: A-
